title: The Minimum wage for the work
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：minimum　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 minimum 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the guide wrote of ① a minimum wage for the work in the guidebook, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so minimum that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the guide, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the minimum ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the minimum wage for the work that anybody there had ever seen, or so the guidebook for July 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too minimum to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the minimum ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a minimum age for the post, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as minimum as the age for the post they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was minimum or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something minimum, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite minimum; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the guidebook kept the names of the minimum ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, in public, she wrote of another minimum wage for the work in the same guidebook, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less minimum than anybody had expected. ⑩ The minimum age for the post that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the minimum ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 最低（前置定语 a minimum wage for the work：1956 年向导在旅行手册里记下的那件最低的工钱）
B. adj. 最低／最小（两处加强说法：so minimum that … 与 no less minimum than …）
C. adj. 最低／最小（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 最低（表语 too minimum to do：母亲觉得它太最低，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 最小（前置定语 a minimum age for the post：叔叔把整件事称作一桩最小的最低年龄）
F. adj. 最小（同级比较 as minimum as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩该职位的最低年龄相比）
G. adj. 最小（后置定语 something minimum：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 最小（受程度副词修饰 quite minimum：那位旅人的评价）

items.q: a minimum wage for the work
the minimum wage for the work that
a minimum age for the post
The minimum age for the post that

answers.why: minimum 意为“最低”，1956 年向导在旅行手册里记下的是“一件最低的工钱”，此处作前置定语 a minimum wage for the work。
minimum 意为“最低”，此处用 so minimum that 结构，说它最低到山谷里没人敢靠近。
minimum 意为“最低”，旅行手册上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的最低这份活的最低工钱，等于最高级的说法。
minimum 意为“最低”，母亲认为这件东西“太最低了，谁也用不上”，too minimum to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
minimum 意为“最小”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩最小的最低年龄”，此处作前置定语 a minimum age for the post。
minimum 意为“最小”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩该职位的最低年龄一样最小”，同级比较用 as minimum as。
minimum 意为“最小”，旅行手册上那半行字要的是“最小的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something minimum。
minimum 意为“最小”，邻山谷来的那位旅人认为这套计划“相当最小”，quite 修饰原级 minimum。
minimum 意为“最小”，no less minimum than 表示“其最小不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之最小不亚于任何人的预料。
minimum 意为“最小”，母亲 1968 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的最小最低年龄”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，向导在旅行手册里记下了一件最低的工钱。（a minimum wage for the work）
它最低到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so minimum that …）
母亲觉得它太最低，谁也用不上。（too minimum to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩最小的最低年龄。（a minimum age for the post）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩该职位的最低年龄一样最小。（as minimum as …）
到了 1963 年，旅行手册上只剩半行字：要的是一件最小的东西。（something minimum）
answers: In 1956 the guide wrote of a minimum wage for the work in the guidebook.
It was so minimum that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too minimum to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a minimum age for the post.
He said nobody would call it as minimum as the age for the post they had once had.
By 1963 the guidebook asked for nothing but something minimum.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 minimum 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the guide wrote of a minimum wage for the work in the guidebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the minimum wage for the work that anybody there had ever seen, or so the guidebook says.
My mother thought it too minimum to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a minimum age for the post, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next valley called the plan quite minimum, and everybody laughed.
The minimum ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
